data.text: Found while adding --ac: cac turns an option value that reads as a number into one, and "" into 0. task edit --title 2026 wrote {"title":2026} into the journal and said it succeeded; task add -d 42 stored a numeric description; decision add --why "", --rejected "" and ac waive --why "" crashed with TypeError on .trim. Present since cac came in. Fixed by shielding such tokens before the parse, as dash-text already is; every number kadence takes goes through Number() anyway.
